description: Replaces quarantined retention_sweeper.py. Retention/lifecycle daemon for age-based expiry of evidence_blob columns (30-day window). Queries mcp_server_registry via write_service, identifies rows where evidence is stale, marks for expiry via update (never DELETE). Must declare heartbeat to service_health. Uses write_service :8772 for all DB access. Implements exponential backoff on 5xx. Does NOT target protected files; is a new named module per spec section 8 naming invariant.
